## Note: Copyright

We strive to use freely accessible literature. If this is not possible, we ask you to obtain the literature via the library platform [LIBER Libraries](https://libereurope.eu/user-list/). Despite valid arguments, we advise against using platforms such as [Anna's Archive](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anna%27s_Archive) or [Library Genesis](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Library_Genesis).

See @karaganis2018shadow
